held on June 27, 2024 at 7:30 p.m. through Zoom Cloud Meeting, to bricf the investors / analysts
about the Company's financial performance and outlook.

number and name of institution they represent in an email to company.sccrctary@trgworld.com
with subject line“Registration for TRG Pakistan Limited Corporate Briefing Session”latest by
